hard_class_invariants.description: No amendment reaches RATIFIED without HUMAN-0 GPG signature slot populated
Amendment ledger entries form valid HMAC-SHA-256 chain
No ledger record mutation after write — append-only
No wall-clock injection; deterministic timestamps only
No amendment advances to PENDING_H0 without simulation pass
Amendment that would violate existing Hard-class invariants is rejected
Ledger write and state update are atomic within a single operation
All stage transitions produce a sealed audit record
SOFT amendments cannot affect Hard-class invariants; HARD requires explicit override
Every ratified amendment references a revert_hash for rollback path
Amendment must cite ≥3 supporting invariant IDs as evidence
Repeated propose() with identical content returns existing record
